part: H - CHECK NEW R_75 HISTORY FIRST
fetch_method: providers.deriv_ws_client.DerivWebSocketClient, public ticks_history (granularity=60, style=candles), paginated backward via `end`, 53 sequential requests

history_depth_probe.method: Empirically tested how far back Deriv's public ticks_history honors an explicit `end` timestamp for R_75 M5 candles, from 1 hour back up to 3 years back.
history_depth_probe.conclusion: Deriv's public feed retains roughly 364-365 days of R_75 history; requests further back silently return the latest candles instead of erroring.

integrity_checks.completed_candles_only: R_75 is a continuously-generated synthetic index with no market close; all M1 candles returned by ticks_history with style=candles are completed by construction (the in-progress candle is never included in a historical count-style request).

deterministic_aggregation.method: providers/multi_timeframe.py::_resample_completed (the exact function production uses for Deriv derived-index symbols, since provider=='deriv' and asset_class=='derived_index' triggers client-side M1->M5/M15/H1 resampling in get_multi_timeframe_context) -- reused verbatim, not reimplemented, to guarantee causal/production fidelity.

sufficiency_assessment.reason_for_using_less_than_the_full_avai: The frozen engine (evaluate_volatility_structure_pullback) takes ~64ms per causal decision-point evaluation with a production-faithful 300-candle trailing window per timeframe. Evaluating at every completed M5 candle across the full available ~364 fresh days (~104,000 decision points) would take several hours of continuous compute inside a single session. 181 days (~52,000 M5 decision points, ~55 minutes of engine evaluation) was chosen as the largest window that is both genuinely new, causally clean, and computationally tractable within this session. This is a disclosed session-resource limitation, not a data-availability limitation -- the additional ~183 days of genuinely fresh, never-consumed history remain available via the same method for a future extension.

required_minimums_assessed_against_181_d.at_least_8_independent_folds_at_15_day_s: 181 days / 15 = 12 possible folds before splitting for holdout; the realized design (below) uses 8 development folds plus a sealed holdout, meeting the >=8 requirement.

decision: PROCEED -- sufficient genuinely new, causally clean history exists to preregister and run the Phase 5 experiment. Full available depth (364 days) was not exhausted; scope and rationale are disclosed above and in the final report.
